From the South with care

Every South Harvest pack carries the same promise: honest ingredients from South India, handled with the care of a home kitchen.

Our promise

From the field to your shelf.

We keep the journey short and simple, so the spice in the pack stays close to how it left the farm.

Step one

Sourced from the South

Whole spices chosen from South Indian growing regions.

Step two

Cleaned & dried

Sorted and dried before grinding, for clean flavour and long shelf life.

Step three

Ground fine

Milled to an even powder that blends smoothly into gravies.

Step four

Sealed fresh

Packed in sealed pouches that lock in aroma until you open them.
